title: Random Pick with Weight
prompt: Given an array `weights` where `weights[i]` is the relative weight of index `i`, implement `Solution(weights)` with a method `pick_index()` that returns an index at random, in proportion to its weight — the same primitive used for weighted/temperature sampling over a probability distribution.
constraints: pick_index() will be called many times and must run efficiently

examples.output: returns index 1 about 3x as often as index 0

test_cases.expected: see prompt — statistical behavior over many calls, not a single deterministic call

hints: Build a prefix-sum array of the weights once, up front, in the constructor.
To pick, draw a uniform random number in [1, total_weight], then find the first prefix-sum index that is >= that number.
Use binary search on the prefix-sum array for that lookup, so pick_index() runs in O(log n) rather than a linear scan.
